description.full:
Generate professional-grade PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents from your own templates and JSON data, one document or a series of documents. Carbone works in Microsoft 365 Copilot: describe what you need in the chat and get a document that follows your company's layout exactly.

What you can do:
- Fill your stored templates (invoices, quotes, contracts, certificates, reports) with data from the conversation, an email, a CRM export or an Excel table.
- Design a new HTML or Markdown template with Carbone, preview it as a PDF and save it to your template library.
- Browse your library by category and tag, see the data each template expects, update its details or publish a new version.
- Add a watermark or an open password to a PDF, and convert documents between formats such as Markdown to Word or Word to PDF.
- Produce the same document in several languages with local date and amount formats.

Try asking:
- "Fill my Invoice template for Northwind Traders: 3 consulting days at 850 EUR, due in 30 days."
- "Show my stored templates by category, with the fields each one expects."
- "Create a PDF training certificate for each of these people: Alice Martin, Bruno Costa, Chen Wei."

Before you start:
- You need a Carbone account. Copilot asks you to sign in on first use, and you can create an account from the sign-in page.
- Each generated document counts against your Carbone plan.
- Without a Carbone Cloud subscription, every document is delivered as a watermarked PDF, whatever format you request. With a subscription, you get any supported format without a watermark.

How documents are delivered: each document comes as a one-time download link in the chat. The link works once and expires shortly, so download the file right away.

Limitations: Carbone can't read files attached to the chat or stored in OneDrive or SharePoint yet. Share a public HTTPS link or paste the content instead. Word, Excel and PowerPoint templates are edited in Office and uploaded through a public link or Carbone Studio.

AI-generated content: this agent uses AI to prepare templates and data, and the result may be inaccurate. Review every document before you share it. To report harmful or inappropriate content, email support@carbone.io.

Help: visit help.carbone.io or email support@carbone.io.
